title: Use Collectors.groupingBy() to group a list of strings by their length
hint: Use Collectors.groupingBy(String::length) to get a Map from length to a list of strings.

title: Use Collectors.toMap() with a merge function to build a frequency map from a List<Integer>
hint: Collect with Collectors.toMap(x -> x, x -> 1, Integer::sum), where the merge function adds counts for repeated keys.

title: Use Streams to find the second-largest/second-smallest number in a list
hint: Stream distinct values, sort them, then skip(1).findFirst() for second-largest using reverseOrder, or the same with natural order for smallest.

title: Given a nested structure (e.g., List<List<Integer>>), use flatMap() to flatten it into a single stream
hint: Call list.stream().flatMap(List::stream) to merge the inner lists into one stream, then collect or process it.

title: Find the second-highest salary from a list of employees using Streams
hint: Take salaries as a stream, apply distinct(), sort in reverse order, skip(1) and findFirst() to get the second-highest.

title: Find the highest salary in each department using Streams
hint: Use groupingBy on department with maxBy(Comparator.comparingDouble(Employee::getSalary)) as the downstream collector, yielding Optional employees per department.

title: Find the frequency of each character in a string using Streams
hint: Convert to chars with chars().mapToObj(c -> (char) c) and collect with groupingBy(Function.identity(), counting()).

title: Group employees by department using Streams
hint: Stream the employees and collect with Collectors.groupingBy(Employee::getDepartment) to get a map of department to employee list.

title: Find the top 3 highest salaries using Streams
hint: Sort salaries in reverse order (optionally after distinct), then use limit(3) to keep the top three.

title: Convert a List<Employee> into a Map<Id, Employee> and handle duplicate keys
hint: Use Collectors.toMap(Employee::getId, Function.identity(), (a, b) -> a) so the merge function resolves duplicate keys instead of throwing.

title: Find duplicate elements in a list using Streams
hint: Add elements to a HashSet and filter those where add() returns false, or group by counting and keep entries with count above one.

title: Find the frequency of each word in a sentence using Streams
hint: Split the sentence on whitespace, stream the words, and collect with groupingBy(Function.identity(), counting()), normalizing case first.

title: Find all employees whose salary is greater than the average salary
hint: Compute the average with mapToDouble(...).average() first, then filter employees whose salary is above that value.

title: Find the Nth highest salary using Streams
hint: Take distinct salaries sorted in descending order, then skip(n-1) and findFirst() to get the Nth highest.
